findings.description: The Presidio & Ferries Railroad ran a horse car section along Washington and Jackson Streets, connecting the ferry terminals to its cable railway terminal. Its horse cars were stabled in the car barn here.

citation.label: Robert Bardell, “The Presidio & Ferries Railroad,” The Argonaut: Journal of the San Francisco Historical Society, vol. 29, no. 2 (Winter 2018), pp. 6–33

findings.description: Stephen Tilton's house of 1872 stood near the centre of his lot at Union and Steiner Streets, beside the Presidio & Ferries cable train terminal, with a four-storey pump house and windmill on the property. It was later moved to 2460 Union Street.
